name: Required Loan ID
description: Loan ID must be present and non-empty.

name: Positive Principal Balance
description: Original principal must be strictly greater than 0.
errorMessage: Original principal cannot be negative or zero

name: Current Balance <= Original Principal
description: Current balance cannot exceed the original principal loan amount.
errorMessage: Current balance exceeds original principal amount

name: Interest Rate Range
description: Interest rate must be within a plausible range (0.5% - 30.0%).

name: Maturity After Origination
description: Maturity date must occur after the origination date.
errorMessage: Maturity date cannot be earlier than origination date

name: Valid US State Code
description: Borrower state must be a valid 2-letter postal abbreviation.

name: Payment Status vs DPD Consistency
description: Payment status must be aligned with days past due.
errorMessage: Payment status conflicts with days past due (e.g. Current with DPD > 0 or 30+ Late with DPD = 0)

name: Closed Loan Zero Balance
description: Loans marked as CLOSED, PAID_OFF, or LIQUIDATED must have a current balance of $0.
errorMessage: Loan marked as CLOSED/PAID_OFF still shows positive current balance

name: Required Document Availability
description: Loan must have complete verified documentation.
errorMessage: Required loan documentation is missing or incomplete

name: Stale Record Detection
description: Flag records where last_updated_at is more than 180 days old.
errorMessage: Record has not been updated in over 180 days (stale servicing feed)

name: Suspicious Repeat Borrower / Near Duplicate
description: Detect duplicate or near-duplicate loans for the same borrower with identical amounts.
errorMessage: Potential duplicate loan record or repeated borrower anomaly detected

name: Mathematical Amortization Schedule Integrity
description: Validates that current balance aligns mathematically with standard compound amortization based on principal, rate, term, and elapsed months.
errorMessage: Current balance mathematically deviates from standard amortization schedule (possible balance inflation or servicer payment miscalculation)
